extracted.intended_audience: photojournalists, picture editors, news organizations, and readers interested in journalism awards
extracted.subtask_description: An announcement/listing of winners for the National Press Photographers Association (NPPA) Best of Photojournalism 2026 competition, organized by divisions and specific award categories. The page names winners (first/second/third/honorable mention) across many categories for stills, video, documentary, and picture editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Still Photojournalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Division heading for awards that recognize excellence in still-image photojournalism across multiple subject and format categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the umbrella for many still-photography award categories (Photojournalist of the Year, breaking news singles, feature singles, etc.). All awards listed are provisional until verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture Editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Division heading for awards recognizing excellence in picture editing, front page/section design, and visual presentation in print and digital.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Picture Editor of the Year, Picture Editing Team of the Year, newspaper and magazine front/section categories, and digital projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Video, Presentation and Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Division heading for awards focused on online video, visual presentations, social video, portfolios, and innovation in digital storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers individual and team video categories, innovation, and online visual presentation formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary
rubrics_metrics.description: Division heading for documentary awards recognizing long-form and short-form documentary storytelling across platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Documentary of the Year, long form, short form, local news documentary, series, and documentary editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video Photojournalism & Editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Division heading for broadcast and video-focused photojournalism and editing awards across markets and formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes awards such as Ernie Crisp Photojournalist of the Year, Editor of the Year, and a range of video story and editing categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photojournalist of the Year – National
rubrics_metrics.description: Top award recognizing an individual photojournalist's national portfolio/work for the year (first/second/third placements listed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as first/second/third places; example winner: Roman Pilipey (Agence France-Presse).

rubrics_metrics.name: Photojournalist of the Year – Community
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing outstanding photojournalistic work produced for community/local outlets (placements listed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists first/second/third and honorable mentions for community-level photojournalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports Photojournalist of the Year
rubrics_metrics.description: Award honoring excellence in sports photography by an individual photojournalist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists placements (first, second, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Emerging Vision Photojournalist of the Year
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing an emerging photographer demonstrating a distinct voice or vision in photojournalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists placements and honorable mentions (e.g., First Place: Liz Rymarev).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cliff Edom New America Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Named award recognizing reporting/photography that illuminates new or undercovered aspects of American life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented with placements and associated story titles (winners listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Breaking News – Singles
rubrics_metrics.description: Category evaluating single images capturing breaking news events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First/second/third and honorable mentions are listed (e.g., Saher Alghorra First Place).

rubrics_metrics.name: Breaking News Story
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for multi-image or story packages documenting breaking news events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards given for cohesive story coverage of breaking events (winners listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: General News – Singles
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for single images covering general/newsworthy events not confined to a single beat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placements and honorable mentions are listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: General News Story
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for multi-image or story packages covering general news topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes cohesive storytelling across multiple images (winners listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature – Singles
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for single images focusing on feature topics (human interest, longer-form subjects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winners listed by placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature Story
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for multi-image feature stories that explore subjects in depth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes narrative and visual cohesion across a series of images.

rubrics_metrics.name: Politics – Singles
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for single images capturing political events, figures, or moments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placements are listed (first/second/third).

rubrics_metrics.name: Politics Story
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for multi-image stories about political subjects or campaigns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards recognize depth and reporting across images.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science – Singles
rubrics_metrics.description: Single-image category focused on science-related subjects or reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placements listed (first/second/third).

rubrics_metrics.name: Science Story
rubrics_metrics.description: Multi-image category for stories exploring scientific or environmental topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes visual reporting and narrative on scientific issues (winners and honorable mentions listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Portrait / Personality – Singles
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for single portrait images that capture character or personality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes first/second/third and honorable mentions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portrait Series
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for multi-image portrait series exploring subjects or communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes series that provide depth and context through portraits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports Action – Singles
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for single sports action photos capturing peak moments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winners listed by placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports Feature – Singles
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for single images that are feature-oriented within sports coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placements and honorable mentions are listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports Picture Story
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for multi-image sports picture stories covering events, athletes, or issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes narrative cohesion and storytelling in sports photography.

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture Editor of the Year – International
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing outstanding picture editing work at the international level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First/second/third placements listed (e.g., Anne Farrar First Place).

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture Editor of the Year – National
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing excellence in picture editing for national publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placements and honorable mentions listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture Editor of the Year – Community
rubrics_metrics.description: Award for picture editors working in community/local outlets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First/second/third placements listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture Editing Team of the Year – International
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing editorial teams for outstanding international picture editing and presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Team winners listed (first/second/third).

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture Editing Team of the Year – National
rubrics_metrics.description: Award for national-level picture editing teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placements listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Picture Editing Team of the Year – Local/Community
rubrics_metrics.description: Award for local/community picture editing teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placements and honorable mentions listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newspaper Front Page
rubrics_metrics.description: Category recognizing excellence in a single newspaper front page's visual presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First/second/third and honorable mention winners are listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newspaper Section Front
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for the visual and editorial design of a newspaper section front.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Winners and honorable mentions listed with titles and outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newspaper General News Story (Picture Editing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category honoring picture editing of general news stories in newspapers (print).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes selection, sequencing, and presentation of images for print news stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newspaper Feature Story (Picture Editing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for picture editing of feature stories in newspapers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates cohesion and presentation in feature-picture packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Magazine Cover
rubrics_metrics.description: Category recognizing excellence in magazine cover photography and design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First/second/third and honorable mentions listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Magazine Feature Story (Picture Editing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for picture editing of magazine feature stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes visual storytelling and presentation across a magazine feature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital General News Story (Picture Editing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for picture editing and visual presentation of general news stories in digital publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates how images are used in digital story contexts (winners listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Feature Story (Picture Editing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category recognizing picture editing and visual presentation of digital feature stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards cohesion and effectiveness of digital visual storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Project (Picture Editing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for large-scale digital visual projects, interactive presentations, or longform digital packages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes innovation and comprehensive visual presentation in digital projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24 Hour – Online Video Individual
rubrics_metrics.description: Online video category for single-individual video pieces produced within a 24-hour timeframe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards quick-turnaround storytelling in online video (placements listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: News and Issue – Online Video Team
rubrics_metrics.description: Online video category for team-produced videos that cover news and public issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes collaborative video storytelling on important topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: News and Issue – Online Video Individual
rubrics_metrics.description: Individual online video works focused on news and issue reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placements listed for individual creators.

rubrics_metrics.name: News and Issue – Online Visual Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Visual-presentation or multimedia entries addressing news and issues in online formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates the visual/interactive presentation of news content online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Race and Identity in America – Online Video Individual
rubrics_metrics.description: Online video category focused on race and identity topics, individual entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes storytelling that explores race and identity issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Race and Identity in America – Online Visual Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Online visual presentation category focused on race and identity topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates presentation and contextualization of race/identity stories in visual formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culture, Sports and Science – Online Video Individual
rubrics_metrics.description: Online video category for individual videos covering culture, sports, or science topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards engaging and well-crafted videos on these beats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culture, Sports, and Science – Online Video Team
rubrics_metrics.description: Team-produced online video entries covering culture, sports, or science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes collaborative video storytelling across these subject areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culture, Sports, and Science – Online Visual Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Online visual presentation category for culture/sports/science topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates design and visual narrative in online presentations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portfolio – Online Video Individual
rubrics_metrics.description: Category recognizing an individual's portfolio of online video work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates breadth, quality, and consistency across a body of online video work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portfolio – Online Visual Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for an organization's or individual's portfolio presented as an online visual collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes comprehensive visual presentation across multiple pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation (Online Video, Presentation and Innovation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category honoring innovative approaches in online video or visual presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates novelty and effectiveness of techniques, formats, or platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Video – Online Video Individual
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for short-format social videos created by an individual for social platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards effective storytelling in social-native video formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Video – Team Online Video
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for team-produced social videos.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes collaborative creation of social-first video content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary of the Year
rubrics_metrics.description: Top documentary award recognizing an outstanding long-form documentary project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented with first-place winner and associated outlet (e.g., ProPublica).

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary Long Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for long-form documentary projects exploring in-depth topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes narrative depth, reporting, and production quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary Short Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for short-form documentary pieces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards concise, powerful documentary storytelling in short formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local News Documentary
rubrics_metrics.description: Category recognizing documentary work focused on local news topics and communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards documentaries produced for local outlets or about local issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary Series
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for multi-episode or serialized documentary projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates consistency, reporting depth, and storytelling across episodes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary Editor
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing excellence in editing for documentary projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights editorial craft behind documentary storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ernie Crisp Photojournalist of the Year (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Top award in the Video Photojournalism & Editing division recognizing an outstanding video photojournalist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists placements and honorable mentions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editor of the Year (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing outstanding editing work in video photojournalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First/second/third placements listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solo Video Journalist of the Year
rubrics_metrics.description: Award for an individual who produces, shoots, and edits their own video journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes versatility and craft across solo-produced video pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporter of the Year (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Award honoring a reporter's excellence in video journalism reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists first/second/third and honorable mentions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Station of the Year – Market 1 (1-34)
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing the top-performing broadcast/newsroom station in the largest market group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First/second/third and honorable mention winners listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Station of the Year – Market 2 (35-210)
rubrics_metrics.description: Award recognizing top-performing broadcast/newsroom stations in smaller market groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placements listed by market grouping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline News (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for video pieces covering breaking or deadline-driven news stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes speed and accuracy in deadline video reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for live video reporting or live-produced video segments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates execution and storytelling under live conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breaking News (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Video category focused on coverage of breaking news events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rewards immediacy, clarity, and visual reportage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily News – Hard (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for hard-news daily video reporting (serious/hard-hitting subjects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes consistency and impact in daily hard-news video coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily News – Light (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for lighter daily news video content (softer features, human interest).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards quality and engagement in lighter daily pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: 60-Minute Edit
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for longer-form, roughly hour-length edited video pieces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates narrative structure and editing across longer packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Feature – Hard (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for in-depth, hard-news feature video packages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes reporting depth and production values on serious feature subjects.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Feature – Light (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for lighter, feature-oriented video packages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards storytelling and production quality in lighter features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports Feature (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for feature-oriented video pieces about sports topics or figures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes narrative and cinematic treatment in sports video features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigative (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for investigative video journalism that uncovers significant wrongdoing or systemic issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates depth of reporting, evidence, and storytelling in investigative video.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effects Edit
rubrics_metrics.description: Category recognizing excellence in effects-based editing work for video packages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards creative/technical editing treatments and use of effects to enhance storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long-Form (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for longer-form video storytelling (beyond short packages), distinct from 60-minute edit entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes sustained narrative and production across extended video pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural Sound-Driven (Video)
rubrics_metrics.description: Category for video pieces driven primarily by natural sound (ambient audio) rather than narration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates the use of natural sound to craft immersive storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: All awards provisional note
rubrics_metrics.description: Editorial/legal note stating that all awards are provisional until verification processes have been completed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates winners listed are subject to verification and possible adjustment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging and committee acknowledgement
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledgement that judging was conducted by more than 170 visual journalists and lists final-round judges by division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides transparency about the judging panel and suggests peer evaluation by experienced visual journalists.
